title: hecos-kb: the HESA HECoS subject vocabulary store
description: Schema for tools/subject/core/vocab/hecos.json (formerly vocab-kb/hecos.json; moved under TLS-1, HMD-1, adp-0204) (HESA Higher Education Classification of Subjects, landed HSV-1, 26 Sep 2026). One entry per HECoS code: its term, definition, scope note, its CAH3 classification (cross-checked against tools/subject/core/vocab/cah.json by the validator, not enforceable by JSON Schema alone), its non-preferred terms and its related codes. A separate nonVocabularyMappings list holds codes named in HESA's mapping data that are absent from HESA's vocabulary data itself (e.g. 200001), so they are never mistaken for a selectable term. House convention: this schema $refs only into common.schema.json, never into itself, for the same offline-resolution reason vocab-kb.schema.json documents.

source.description: Provenance for the vocabulary as a whole: issuer, release, licence, where and how it was retrieved, and the source files it was built from.

vocabulary.description: Name of the vocabulary, e.g. Higher Education Classification of Subjects (HECoS).

release.description: HESA's own release/version label for HECoS, or null if HESA's pages give none.

licence.description: The vocabulary's own licence, if HESA states one for it.

value.description: The licence identifier, e.g. CC-BY-4.0, or null if HESA states none.

url.description: The page stating the licence (or its absence), or null.

provenance.description: How this copy reached the repo, e.g. supplied by Abbott, downloaded from HESA.

files.description: The source CSV(s) this store was built from: name, content hash, and data-row count, so a re-run can be checked for drift.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file's bytes with a trailing newline stripped.

note.description: Free-text provenance detail, e.g. that HESA's pages give no HECoS version or release date.

terms.description: One entry per HECoS code in HESA's vocabulary data. Zero entries is a fail, never a vacuous pass.

term.description: HESA's own term, stored exactly as supplied: never rewritten, recased or corrected.

definition.description: HESA's own definition, stored exactly as supplied.

scopeNote.description: HESA's own scope note, or null where HESA supplies none.

cah3.description: The CAH3 code this term maps to. Structural-invariant checked (resolves to an existing cah3 row in tools/subject/core/vocab/cah.json), not enforceable by JSON Schema alone.

nonPreferredTerms.description: Alternate terms HESA records for this code. Empty list where HESA records none.

relatedCodes.description: Other HECoS codes HESA records as related to this one. Empty list where HESA records none.

nonVocabularyMappings.description: HECoS codes named in HESA's mapping data that are absent from HESA's vocabulary data itself, e.g. 200001. Never among terms; always non-selectable.

label.description: HESA's own label for the code, stored exactly as supplied.

selectable.description: Always false: a non-vocabulary mapping is never offered as a choice.
